title.zh: 启程 · 通往霍格沃茨

completion_text.zh:
远处城堡的灯火穿过薄雾，一盏接一盏亮起。你跟随一年级新生走向等待的小船，知道真正的校园生活就在黑湖彼岸。

通往霍格沃茨的旅程已经完成，分院仪式已解锁。
completion_text.en:
Beyond the mist, the castle lights appear one by one. You follow the other first-years towards the waiting boats, knowing that school life begins across the Black Lake.

The journey to Hogwarts is complete. The Sorting Ceremony is now unlocked.

narration.zh: 巨大的车站穹顶把脚步声、汽笛声和广播声混在一起。你的车票上清楚写着“九又四分之三站台”，可九号与十号站台之间只有一道结实的砖墙。装着宠物的笼箱在行李车上轻轻晃动，几名麻瓜旅客好奇地看了你一眼。
narration.en: Beneath the vast station roof, footsteps, whistles, and announcements blur together. Your ticket clearly says Platform Nine and Three-Quarters, yet only a solid brick barrier stands between Platforms Nine and Ten. Your pet carrier rocks gently on the trolley while several Muggle travellers glance your way.

revisit_narration.zh: 车站大钟又向前跳了一格。九号与十号站台之间的砖墙依然沉默，列车却不会永远等下去。
revisit_narration.en: The station clock advances another minute. The barrier between Platforms Nine and Ten remains silent, but the train will not wait forever.

text.zh: “九又四分之三？孩子，这里可没有那样的站台。”
text.en: “Nine and three-quarters? No such platform here, kid.”

player_text.zh: 你把车票翻来覆去地检查。
player_text.en: You turn the ticket over and study every mark.

text.zh: 车票背面的墨迹在灯下短暂浮起：不要停，不要犹豫，径直向前。
text.en: For a moment, ink rises on the back of the ticket: Do not stop. Do not hesitate. Go straight ahead.

player_text.zh: 你压低声音，问他是否见过带猫头鹰和大箱子的学生。
player_text.en: You lower your voice and ask whether he has seen students with owls and enormous trunks.

text.zh: 他刚要摇头，目光却越过你，看向一户推着同样行李的家庭。“也许你该跟紧他们。”
text.en: He starts to shake his head, then looks past you towards a family pushing identical luggage. “Perhaps you ought to follow them.”

label.en: Follow the family with an owl

player_text.zh: 你推着行李，不远不近地跟上那户同样带着猫头鹰的家庭。
player_text.en: You push your trolley after the family carrying an owl, keeping a careful distance.

text.zh: 走在最前面的孩子没有减速，连人带车消失在砖墙之中。轮到你时，你握紧推车把手，向前跑去。
text.en: The child in front does not slow down and vanishes through the barrier with the trolley. When your turn comes, you tighten your grip and run straight ahead.

narration.zh: 白色蒸汽从猩红列车下翻涌而出，站台上到处是告别、拥抱和失控的宠物。一名与你年龄相仿的学生正努力把过重的箱子抬上车门踏板。
narration.en: White steam billows beneath a scarlet train. The platform is crowded with farewells, embraces, and runaway pets. A student about your age is struggling to lift an oversized trunk onto the carriage step.

revisit_narration.zh: 列车喷出一阵新的蒸汽，车门旁的学生仍在和那只沉重的箱子较劲。
revisit_narration.en: The train releases another cloud of steam. The student by the carriage is still wrestling with the heavy trunk.

text.zh: “如果这箱子再重一点，我怀疑里面就装着一座城堡。”
text.en: “If this trunk were any heavier, I would assume there was a castle inside it.”

text.zh: “你回来了。至少现在这只箱子已经承认我们赢了。”
text.en: “You came back. At least the trunk has admitted we won.”

player_text.zh: 你走过去托住箱子的另一侧。
player_text.en: You step over and take the other side of the trunk.

text.zh: 箱子终于滑进车厢。罗温喘着气伸出手：“我叫罗温。看来我们已经共同打败了第一个校内敌人。”
text.en: The trunk finally slides aboard. Rowan offers a breathless hand. “I'm Rowan. It seems we have already defeated our first school enemy together.”

player_text.zh: 你告诉罗温自己的名字，并问车上是否还有空位。
player_text.en: You tell Rowan your name and ask whether there is still a free compartment.

text.zh: “最后一节还有位置。如果你不介意和一只很有主见的箱子同行的话。”
text.en: “There is room near the last carriage, if you do not mind travelling with a very opinionated trunk.”

player_text.zh: 汽笛第一次响起，你提起行李登上列车。
player_text.en: At the first whistle, you lift your luggage and board the train.

narration.zh: 车轮开始有节奏地敲击铁轨，伦敦的屋顶逐渐让位给田野与远山。包厢门外不时有学生跑过，糖果推车的铃声正从走廊另一端靠近。
narration.en: The wheels settle into a steady rhythm as London rooftops give way to fields and distant hills. Students hurry past the compartment door, and the sweet trolley's bell draws nearer along the corridor.

revisit_narration.zh: 窗外的天色更深了一些，列车仍坚定地向北行驶。
revisit_narration.en: The sky beyond the window has darkened, and the train continues steadily north.

text.zh: “给你留了靠窗的位置。毕竟打败过同一只箱子的人应该坐在一起。”
text.en: “I saved you the window seat. People who defeat the same trunk ought to sit together.”

text.zh: “这里还有位置。我也是第一次去，不知道应该紧张到什么程度。”
text.en: “There is a seat here. It is my first time too, so I am not sure how worried we are meant to be.”

text.zh: 你的猫头鹰在笼中转过头，认真观察着飞速后退的电线杆。
text.en: Your owl turns inside its cage and solemnly watches the telegraph poles race backwards.

text.zh: 你的猫毫不客气地占据了座位一角，仿佛车票本来就是为它买的。
text.en: Your cat claims a corner of the seat as though the ticket had always been purchased in its name.

text.zh: 软垫盒里传来一声低低的蛙鸣，像是在确认列车准时出发。
text.en: A low croak comes from the padded box, as though confirming that the train departed on schedule.

player_text.zh: 糖果推车经过时，你买下一小袋糖果，推到两人中间。
player_text.en: When the trolley passes, you buy a small bag of sweets and set it between you.

text.zh: 罗温挑了一颗会轻轻发光的糖。“如果分院仪式很可怕，我们至少不用空着肚子面对它。”
text.en: Rowan chooses a sweet that glows faintly. “If the Sorting is terrifying, at least we will not face it on an empty stomach.”

player_text.zh: 你靠近车窗，看田野变成山谷，云影掠过越来越陌生的土地。
player_text.en: You lean towards the window as fields become valleys and cloud-shadows cross unfamiliar country.

text.zh: 有一段时间，谁都没有说话。这份沉默并不尴尬，反而像旅程本身一样平稳。
text.en: For a while, neither of you speaks. The silence is not awkward; it feels as steady as the journey itself.

label.en: Change into robes and prepare to leave

player_text.zh: 广播提醒学生换上校袍。你收好车票，把行李重新扣紧。
player_text.en: An announcement tells students to change into school robes. You put away your ticket and fasten your luggage.

narration.zh: 夜色和冷空气一起涌进车厢。站台尽头，一盏高高举起的灯在薄雾里摇晃，低年级学生正被召集到一起。山坡上方，城堡的窗户像散落的星光。
narration.en: Night air pours into the carriage. At the far end of the platform, a raised lantern sways in the mist while the first-years are called together. Above the hillside, the castle windows shine like scattered stars.

revisit_narration.zh: 新生们逐渐在灯光下聚齐，远处黑湖的水面映着城堡。
revisit_narration.en: The first-years gather beneath the lantern while the distant Black Lake reflects the castle.

text.zh: “一年级新生，到灯这边来！行李会有人送进城堡，你们只管跟紧。”
text.en: “First-years, over by the lantern! Your luggage will reach the castle—just stay together.”

label.zh: 跟随一年级新生前往湖边
label.en: Follow the first-years to the lake

player_text.zh: 你与罗温并肩加入新生队伍，跟随灯光走向湖边。
player_text.en: You join the line beside Rowan and follow the lantern towards the lake.

text.zh: “不管分到哪里，明天早餐时告诉我你的楼梯有没有也会移动。”
text.en: “Wherever we are sorted, tell me at breakfast whether your staircases move too.”
